name: list_artifacts
description: Saved artifacts, newest first — current conversation unless all_conversations.

name: read_artifact
description: Markdown content of an artifact — latest, or a specific version.

name: list_artifact_versions
description: Version history for an artifact, oldest first.

name: list_documents
description: Files attached to this conversation: id, filename, size, on-disk path, index state.

name: document_path
description: The on-disk path of an attached file, for opening it with code.

name: search_documents
description: Top-k passages from this conversation's indexed attachments.

name: read_document
description: Sequential window of an indexed document; continue with offset=next_offset.

name: search_conversations
description: Past conversations that mention `query`, best match first.

name: read_conversation
description: The last `limit` messages of a conversation, oldest first.

name: list_conversations
description: The other conversations in this project, most recently active first.

name: list_automations
description: All automations with id, name, input_type, schedule, enabled.

name: create_automation
description: Create an automation — a task that runs on a cron schedule or on demand.

name: update_automation
description: Update an automation. Pass only the fields to change.

name: delete_automation
description: Delete an automation by id.

name: list_tasks
description: Board tasks (durable background work items), highest priority first.

name: create_task
description: Create a durable board task that runs in the background on its own agent.

name: list_workflows
description: All saved workflows with id, name, description.

name: read_workflow
description: A workflow including its full `definition` JSON (nodes + edges).

name: create_workflow
description: Create a workflow — a graph of nodes for multi-step pipelines.

name: update_workflow
description: Update a workflow. Pass only what changes: name, description, definition.

name: delete_workflow
description: Delete a workflow by id.

name: list_skills
description: All skills with id, name, description, enabled (bodies not included).

name: use_skill
description: Load a saved skill's full body — the procedure to follow.

name: create_skill
description: Save a reusable procedure you can reload later with use_skill(name).

name: update_skill
description: Update a skill. Pass only what changes: name, description, body, enabled.

name: delete_skill
description: Delete a skill by id.

name: search_memory
description: Top-k long-term memory facts for `query` by cosine similarity.

name: project_memory
description: Read or update the shared memory of this conversation's project.

name: mcp_servers
description: List connected MCP servers: name, load mode, and tool count.

name: mcp_tools
description: Tool names + descriptions for one MCP server (or all of them).

name: mcp_help
description: Full description + JSON argument schema for one MCP tool.

name: mcp_call
description: Call one MCP tool and return its output as text.

name: text_to_speech
description: Synthesize speech from text using the local Piper TTS voice.
